requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles that support 6,000 pages for Black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink supply efficiency and meet higher usage demands for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, Product Management, SMB & Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, Magi/Nessie inks, and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles must achieve specified page yields in internal and customer testing; bottles must be keyed for correct installation.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure that the new NGB bottles provide spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce customer complaints and warranty claims related to ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle and NOA-F interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Less than 0.1% reported spill incidents in field testing and warranty period.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label into the NOA-F component, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and traceability of the NOA-F component.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing NOA-F design, push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All NOA-F units must include metal foil labyrinth and lid label, verified by QA inspection.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks with no reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and reduce development time and cost.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes all reliability and PQ tests using existing inks and PHA.

requirements.Title: Reliability and IDS Characterization & Modelling
requirements.Description: Perform full reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F EOL.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust performance and accurate modeling for maintenance and support planning.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to prototypes and test data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive reports and models delivered and reviewed by R&D and QA.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling for Tank
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To predict and mitigate potential ink degradation and ensure consistent PQ.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank material and design, ink chemistry.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling results reviewed and approved by R&D; test results confirm predictions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F components as service parts for in-warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To enable field replacement and reduce turnaround time for warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Availability of NOA-F as separate SKU.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F listed and available as a service part; documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed security/authentication feature) on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security and prevent counterfeiting.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle lid design, Acumen 6 component availability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids feature Acumen 6; passes authentication tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, and add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: To support new product configuration and ensure manufacturing readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Line modifications completed and validated before pilot run.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design printer to allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components without professional service.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability, reduce downtime, and enhance user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of PHA/NOA-F modules, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Replacement process validated by usability testing with non-technical users.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer platform supports a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet the needs of high-usage environments and competitive warranty offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages without major failures.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Business Models (Consumer, SMB, Enterprise)
requirements.Description: Enable the product to be configurable for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including services like PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker.
requirements.Rationale: To address diverse market segments and maximize market coverage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product configurations and service options documented and available for all target segments.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product (PDL SKU) meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental regulations and enhance marketability in eco-conscious regions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certifications obtained prior to product launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and minimize footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Prototypes pass fit and function tests with new tank design.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Touchscreen
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) touchscreen for user interaction.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience and align with modern product expectations.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UI/UX Design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Touchscreen passes usability and reliability tests; meets brightness and resolution specs.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system (4-tube platform).
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink flow and reliability while leveraging existing components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes flow and reliability tests with new routing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station, with spit platform changes due to tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain print quality and prevent contamination from aerosolized ink.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels measured and within acceptable limits during operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Tube and Weights
requirements.Description: Update the carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and additional weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable printhead movement and avoid mechanical failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube and tank design, carriage design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic stress and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design the paper path to support increased printer page life.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation over the extended warranty period and page life goal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes accelerated life and reliability testing for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design an ink maintenance component that is serviceable at the service center after 80,000 page life.
requirements.Rationale: To extend printer usability and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Part can be replaced at service center; process documented and validated.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection in the Ink Delivery System, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To improve fluidic reliability and prevent incorrect installation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connection passes reliability and usability tests; keying prevents misinstallation.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable startup and prevent air bubbles in the ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm validated in lab and field testing; startup success rate >99%.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithms to support new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure optimal operation and user experience with new system components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms pass validation in simulated and real-world conditions.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Define and validate new print quality goals and depletion algorithms to meet updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure customer satisfaction and compliance with page yield claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics meet or exceed targets in internal and field testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi Module, and Dune FW
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi module, and Dune firmware for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development time, cost, and risk by reusing proven hardware and software components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform and features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function correctly in system integration and validation tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware-based security features.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security and meet corporate security standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external penetration tests.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer achieves print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 25/19 ppm for PDL.
requirements.Rationale: To meet competitive benchmarks and customer expectations in target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard and PDL tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages, 2 Years
requirements.Description: Support a warranty life of pages (as specified) for 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: To align with market expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms validated and supported by accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box for easy serviceability, allowing for quick replacement or maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce downtime and service costs for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Box can be serviced in under 10 minutes by trained personnel.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Include features and manageability tailored for SMB customers, such as SMB portal and management tools.
requirements.Rationale: To increase adoption in the SMB segment and provide value-added services.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Product Management, IT Admins
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB management features available and tested with pilot SMB customers.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Enable the product for Printing as a Service (PaaS) business model, including necessary software and service hooks.
requirements.Rationale: To support new business models and recurring revenue streams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features enabled and validated in end-to-end testing.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solutions for consumer, SMB, and enterprise use cases.
requirements.Rationale: To provide a complete multifunction device and address diverse customer needs.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, SMB/Enterprise IT
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scanning functions validated across all target segments and use cases.

requirements.Title: Enterprise Support: WJA, HPSM, JAM
requirements.Description: Support for enterprise management tools: Web Jetadmin (WJA), HP Smart Management (HPSM), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: To enable enterprise customers to manage and monitor devices at scale.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device is discoverable and manageable in WJA, HPSM, and JAM environments.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility and support for a range of client and driver solutions: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize compatibility and ease of deployment for all customer segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All drivers and client solutions tested and available at launch.
